name: daos-ui
scope: Qt/PyQt and their complete pkgsrc package dependency closure are upstream binary packages. NetBSD base/X11 and the DaOS native camera are source-built separately. This is not an all-source Qt build, and ABI metadata checks do not establish target execution.
postinstall: Host staging executes no target package scripts. The supplied offline native pkg_add finalizer completes package registration and install scripts on NetBSD before release acceptance.
